buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Nothing decisive on freshness, though it tilts slightly to Riera. Oz has logged 46 games across 2 matches in 14 days, Riera only 20 across 1.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Motivation and pressure point fairly clearly to Riera. Riera is playing at home in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and the crowd should help with the big points. When it goes the distance, Riera has won 61% of deciding sets over the past year to Oz's 33%.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: This is one-sided on conditions: Riera. Riera rates +28 Elo points better on Clay than overall; for Oz it is -16. Riera is the more proven player on Clay: 56% wins in 12 months against 42% for Oz.
